verdict.rationale: Meilisearch presents itself as API-first: storage, full-text, semantic and conversational search are all exposed 'from a single API' [docs-1]. The core operations from the web-interface walkthrough (creating indexes, adding documents, configuring settings, searching) are also available programmatically through the native MCP endpoint and typed SDKs [docs-13, docs-78, docs-50]. Relevancy settings such as typo tolerance and ranking rules are configurable per index [docs-31, docs-23]. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that Cloud project management (creating projects, billing, team settings) is exposed via API, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404) [probe-3].
